description: Supply-chain Tier A automation for Andromeda. See docs/development/supply-chain.md.
THIS FILE IS INERT UNTIL THE RENOVATE GITHUB APP IS INSTALLED ON THE REPOSITORY.
Renovate is a GitHub App, not a workflow: config alone opens no pull requests.
Do NOT re-pin quay.io/fedora/fedora-bootc by digest until Renovate is live and
has proven it can raise a digest-refresh PR -- Fedora garbage-collects superseded
fedora-bootc digests from quay.io within days, which is what broke every build in
Actions run 30702410393 and forced the un-pin in commit d27cefa.
os/scripts/build-iso.sh pins ghcr.io/osbuild/image-builder-cli by digest
inside a plain shell parameter default that no built-in manager parses.
Without this entry that pin has NO refresh path: it crosses the 90-day
age budget and stays permanently STALE in check-pin-freshness.sh with
nothing ever opening the refresh PR. The digest tracks :latest
(currentValueTemplate); Renovate rewrites only the sha256 capture group
in place, leaving the surrounding shell syntax untouched.
Tier A: container base images must stay pinned by digest, and the pin must
stay fresh. pinDigests makes Renovate rewrite a bare tag into tag@sha256:...
on first run -- that Pin PR is itself the proof that the automation works,
so it is the correct way to re-pin fedora-bootc rather than doing it by hand.
Digest refreshes must NOT wait for the weekly window. quay.io prunes
superseded fedora-bootc digests within days, so a pin that Renovate notices
on Tuesday but only files on Monday can rot in between. Run these at any
time and give them priority over everything else in the queue.
Cooling-off (minimumReleaseAge) is deliberately NOT applied here: for a
digest refresh, delay is the failure mode, not the mitigation.
The dedicated groupName matters: packageRules merge per-field with later
rules winning, so without it digest updates would inherit 'container base
images' from the rule above and land on the WEEKLY version-bump branch --
silently defeating the at-any-time schedule and prPriority set here.
custom.regex is included so the build-iso.sh image-builder-cli digest
(see customManagers) refreshes on the same no-wait terms.
THIRD-PARTY GitHub Actions stay pinned to a full commit SHA with the
version as a trailing comment, which is the policy already documented in
ci.yml and os-e2e.yml. Renovate updates the SHA and rewrites that comment
in step. Grouped into one PR because action bumps are low-risk and
reviewing five separate SHA diffs a week is how pin hygiene gets
abandoned. First-party actions/* are exempted by the NEXT rule (later
rules win per-field), keeping them on major tags per the same policy.
First-party actions/* are pinned to major tags by repository policy
(ci.yml: 'first-party actions/* are pinned to major tags; third-party
actions are pinned to a full commit SHA'). pinDigests: false is
load-bearing: the previous rule sets pinDigests: true for ALL
github-actions deps, and without this per-field override Renovate's
first run would propose rewriting actions/checkout@v4 to a SHA --
directly against the documented policy. This is also why the
helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests preset is NOT in extends: the explicit
rule above already covers third-party pinning, and the preset would
only restate the blanket pin this rule exists to carve out.
Grouped separately so a deliberate future move to SHA pinning is one
reviewable PR rather than noise mixed into third-party bumps.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes bypass the weekly window entirely.
